1.title: Trump Lifts Ban on Direct Flights to Lebanon
1.summary: The prohibition had been in place since 1985, when it was imposed in response to Hezbollah’s hijacking of TWA Flight 847.

2.title: Iran war has cost US $37.5bn so far, Hegseth says, as Pentagon seeks billions more
2.summary: Some senators pushed back on Hegseth's funding request as he testified at a pivotal time in the war.

3.title: With His Latest Threats, Trump Signals to Iran That He Is Willing to Escalate
3.summary: President Trump is facing a critical moment in the war, which has failed to bring about the “unconditional surrender” he once demanded.

4.title: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
4.summary: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after backlash over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

5.title: Zelensky Dismisses Ukraine’s Top General After Protests
5.summary: The move followed the firing of a popular defense minister, who had clashed with the general over how to fight the war.

6.title: Netanyahu Ad Uses a Questionable Tactic Against Bereaved Rival
6.summary: A.I.-generated images showing Gadi Eisenkot, the Israeli leader’s top challenger in upcoming elections, played on anti-Arab sentiments and used images seen as disrespectful to his son, who was killed in the recent Gaza war.
